shared_elements: relief decoration on a flat slab or pillar face
curving linear form resembling a stem, tendril, or serpent
bands or zones of repeated linear pattern
justification: The most specific overlap is that both surfaces use relief outlines to show profile creature forms alongside repeated linear patterning and some curving/rounded motifs. The biggest difference is compositional and stylistic: A is dominated by one finely detailed kneeling winged figure beside a plant-like vertical element, while B is a rougher, schematic stone surface organized in stacked zones of separate signs and animals.
